hooks.command: h="${SUB_HUMAN_HOME:-$HOME/.sub-human}/sessions"; s="$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"; case "$s" in ""|*/*|.*) cat >/dev/null; exit 0;; esac; [ -e "$h/by-sid/$s.json" ] || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; m=$(tr -d '\n' | sed -n 's/.*"permission_mode": *"\([A-Za-z]*\)".*/\1/p'); [ -n "$m" ] || exit 0; umask 077; mkdir -p "$h/mode" 2>/dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$m" > "$h/mode/$s" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

h="${SUB_HUMAN_HOME:-$HOME/.sub-human}/sessions"; s="$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"; [ -z "$s" ] || [ -e "$h/mods/$s.json" ] || [ -e "$h/by-sid/$s.json" ] || [ -e "$h/by-pid/$CLAUDE_PID.json" ] || { while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; exit 0; }; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/node.sh" --import "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/compile-cache.js" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.ts" session-end
